summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration that sets up two connected services: a Joomla web application and a MySQL database. The Joomla service exposes itself on port 8080 and connects to the database service using environment variables, while the database service initializes with a root password. Both services are set to restart automatically if they crash.

explanations.6: The %%port=8080%% syntax is a template placeholder that will be replaced with an actual port number at deployment time; the :80 part means container port 80 (where Joomla listens) will be accessible at that external port.
explanations.8: JOOMLA_DB_HOST tells the Joomla container where to find its database — 'joomladb' is the service name, which Docker's networking automatically resolves to the correct IP address.
explanations.9: The %%dbPassword=example%% placeholder will be replaced with an actual password before deployment; it's the same password variable used for the database so Joomla can authenticate when connecting.
explanations.15: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD sets the administrative password for the MySQL database when it first starts up — this must match the password Joomla uses to connect.
